description: Χάρτης Κυκλοφοριακών Ρυθμίσεων Δήμου Ιλίου is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Τμήμα Συγκοινωνιών και Κυκλοφορίας. Dati geospaziali sulle disposizioni in materia di traffico che mostrano strade pedonali, strade unidirezionali (in tempo) e strade bidirezionali. Coverage: Τμήμα Συγκοινωνιών και Κυκλοφορίας. The portal shows the English title as "Carte de la Municipalité d'Ilion" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Τμήμα Συγκοινωνιών και Κυκλοφορίας. Its keywords include Από μετάπτωση, Γεωχωρικά, repository.data.gov.gr. The listing shows 1 download or service links in DWG. The listing shows 2026-02-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
